description: What changed on Redstick's record since a date: every tool whose record changed, in full, with those changes. Paid per call by x402 in USDC: $0.05 a call including the first 10 tools returned, then $0.02 for each further tool (the most a call can cost, at 200 tools, is $3.850); set limit to hold the cost. The exact price is stated before anything is paid. A call that cannot be answered as asked, or that finds nothing, is free.

country.description: two-letter country code where the tool is sold, e.g. GB

has_video.description: true: only tools whose page carries the maker's own video of it working

maker_country.description: the maker's country by name, e.g. Germany

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD: tools whose record changed on or after this date, with those changes

name: what_changed
title: What changed since a date (paid)
